body: Vibe.Mls.post_welcome had NO membership check: any authenticated user could claim a victim KeyPackage (GET /mls/key-packages/:user_id, no relationship check), build an MLS group, and POST a Welcome naming any chat_id (mls_welcomes.chat_id is a plain :string, no FK) — seating the victim in an attacker-controlled group. Worse since the client stopped discarding groups when incomingWelcomes>0. FIXED: authorize_welcome/3 requires BOTH sender and recipient to be Chat.is_participant? of chat_id; 404 not 403 so chat ids cannot be probed. mix compile green.
author: Vibe Team
